scope: Safest partial recovery from legacy corpus; NOT a full back-translation-benefit experiment
normalization: Unicode NFKC; whitespace collapse/trim; casefold; Text retained unchanged for models
punctuation_variant_key: Unicode word tokens plus preserved operators <>=+/%#@&|^~; join with spaces; only co-isolation evidence

retention: Only normalized Text matches to raw original; final Class must agree with raw; family must pass all quarantine checks; one model example per normalized original Text (first final row). ALL unlinked rows excluded even if lexically similar.
quality_gate: Full-25k provenance FAIL without verified parentage; partial recovery PASS only on declared textual/accounting/quarantine/stratification checks; semantic recall UNKNOWN; never claim leakage-free.
old_frozen_validation_comparison: Old 0.581140 belongs to another partition and is NOT directly comparable
threshold_selection: Declared before graph construction/splitting/baseline; no outcome-dependent revisions allowed
scientific_limitations: Raw-matched content identity is not causal parentage
Excluding unlinked variants does not measure augmentation benefit
New split may reuse original old-held-out requirements; resulting models ineligible for original frozen test

bert_recipe.initialization: Original pretrained bert-base-uncased only; never a historical fine-tuned checkpoint
